text:
The tail NMOS is in triode. With vin = 0.75 V and an NMOS pair Vgs of about 0.68 V, the tail node sits at 0.067 V. That leaves no headroom, cuts current to about 72 µA and drops gm, so gain and GBW fail. The fix is a PMOS-input 5T OTA:
- The input pair bulk is tied to the tail, which removes body effect.
- The PMOS tail is biased from a small mirror off the existing ibias diode.
- The tail gets about 0.25–0.3 V of Vsd.
- The load is an NMOS mirror, putting output DC near 0.6–0.7 V.
- vin drives the diode-side device, so the output stays non-inverting.

```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "NMOS tail in triode (tail node 0.067 V): an NMOS pair can't fit under vin=0.75 V. Switch to PMOS-input 5T OTA (bulk tied to tail), PMOS tail fed by a 5 uA mirror off ibias, NMOS mirror load. vin stays on diode side so output is non-inverting. Full It now flows, raising gm, and longer L adds gain."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "It":    (90e-6, 75e-6, 95e-6),   # tail current
    "Ib2":   (5e-6, 3e-6, 8e-6),      # PMOS bias branch current
    "gmid":  (22.0, 16.0, 25.0),      # input pair gm/Id
    "Lin":   (0.35, 0.15, 0.8),       # input pair L
    "gml":   (12.0, 8.0, 18.0),       # NMOS load gm/Id
    "Ll":    (0.5, 0.15, 1.5),        # NMOS load L
    "gmt":   (13.0, 9.0, 18.0),       # tail gm/Id
    "Lt":    (0.5, 0.3, 2.0),         # tail / bias L
    "Lr":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),         # reference diode L
    "dv":    (0.0, -0.02, 0.02),      # trim of reference voltage vs vin
}

def _bisect(lut, typ, L, I, vds, vgs_target, lo=3.0, hi=27.0):
    for _ in range(40):
        mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
        o = lut.size(typ, mid, L, I, vds=vds)
        if abs(o.vgs) > vgs_target:
            lo = mid
        else:
            hi = mid
    return lut.size(typ, 0.5 * (lo + hi), L, I, vds=vds)

def _fing(W, wmax=8.0):
    nf = max(1, int(round(W / wmax)))
    return max(0.42, W / nf), nf

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vin = spec.get("vin_dc", 0.75)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    It, Ib2, gmid, Lin = p["It"], p["Ib2"], p["gmid"], p["Lin"]
    gml, Ll, gmt, Lt, Lr, dv = p["gml"], p["Ll"], p["gmt"], p["Lt"], p["Lr"], p["dv"]
    Ih = It / 2.0

    # NMOS mirror load: diode level = output DC
    m3 = lut.size("n", gml, Ll, Ih, vds=0.65)
    vo = m3.vgs
    m3 = lut.size("n", gml, Ll, Ih, vds=vo)
    # PMOS input pair, bulk tied to tail (no body effect)
    m1 = lut.size("p", gmid, Lin, Ih, vds=0.8)
    vtail = vin + abs(m1.vgs)
    m1 = lut.size("p", gmid, Lin, Ih, vds=max(0.1, vtail - vo))
    vtail = vin + abs(m1.vgs)
    # reference diode (in- = ibias = vin replica)
    vref = vin + dv
    mr = _bisect(lut, "n", Lr, iref, vref, vref)
    # NMOS sink for PMOS bias branch, same L / gate as reference -> scaled width
    Wb_tot = mr.W * Ib2 / iref
    # PMOS bias diode and tail (matched Vsg)
    mpb = lut.size("p", gmt, Lt, Ib2, vds=0.7)
    mpb = lut.size("p", gmt, Lt, Ib2, vds=abs(mpb.vgs))
    vsd_t = max(0.05, vdd - vtail)
    mt = _bisect(lut, "p", Lt, It, vsd_t, abs(mpb.vgs))

    W1, nf1 = _fing(m1.W)
    W3, nf3 = _fing(m3.W)
    Wr, nfr = _fing(mr.W)
    Wb, nfb = _fing(Wb_tot)
    Wpb, nfpb = _fing(mpb.W)
    Wt, nft = _fing(mt.W)

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.M("MREF", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wr, Lr, m=nfr)
    n.M("MB", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wb, Lr, m=nfb)
    n.M("MPB", "pb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wpb, Lt, m=nfpb)
    n.M("MT", "tail", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wt, Lt, m=nft)
    # vin on diode side -> non-inverting output on M2 side
    n.M("M1", "d1", "vin", "tail", "tail", "pfet", W1, Lin, m=nf1)
    n.M("M2", "vout", "ibias", "tail", "tail", "pfet", W1, Lin, m=nf1)
    n.M("M3", "d1", "d1", "vss", "vss", "nfet", W3, Ll, m=nf3)
    n.M("M4", "vout", "d1", "vss", "vss", "nfet", W3, Ll, m=nf3)

    gm = m1.gm
    gds = m1.gds + m3.gds
    ctot = cl + m1.cdd + m3.cdd + m1.cgd + m3.cgd
    A = gm / gds
    f3 = gds / (2 * PI * ctot)
    gbw = gm / (2 * PI * ctot)
    vout_dc = vo
    swing = (vtail - abs(m1.vdsat) - 0.05) - (m3.vdsat + 0.05)
    power = vdd * (iref + Ib2 + It)
    return n, {"gain_db": db(A), "f3db": f3, "gbw": gbw, "power": power,
               "vout_dc": vout_dc, "swing": swing}
```
